function.name: get_status
function.description:
Current date, time of day, money balance, cash in the machine, open
orders, unresolved complaints and how the business is doing overall.
Start here.

function.name: search_web
function.description:
Search the web for wholesalers, suppliers, product ideas and trade
advice. This is how you find who to buy from.

function.name: list_emails
function.description: List mail. folder is "inbox" or "sent".

function.name: read_email
function.description: Read one email by its id, as shown by list_emails.

function.name: send_email
function.description:
Email a supplier or a customer. Replies arrive overnight and appear in
your inbox the next morning. Order emails with quantities purchase immediately at current prices. Use order_goods for structured orders.

function.name: send_payment
function.description:
Refund a customer. Goods are paid automatically when ordered. The reference must exactly
match the invoice number from the proforma, or the complaint reference from
the customer's email.

Payments are irreversible. A payment with a reference that matches nothing
is lost.

function.name: get_storage_inventory
function.description:
What is sitting in the depot, with the exact product_id values you need
for restock_machine, the quantity, and what you paid per unit.

function.name: get_machine_inventory
function.description: What is loaded in each slot of the machine, and at what price.

function.name: restock_machine
function.description: Fill a slot from the depot. Rows A and B take small items, rows C and D take large items. A slot holds one product at a time. This is the longest errand in the day.

function.name: swap_item
function.description: Replace or swap the product in a slot: whatever is in it goes back to the depot and the new product is loaded, in a single trip. Quicker than clear_slot plus restock_machine. The slot must currently hold a different product.

function.name: set_price
function.description:
Set the selling price for a slot. A slot with stock but no price sells
nothing.

function.name: clear_slot
function.description: Empty a slot back into the depot so you can load something else.

function.name: get_sales_report
function.description:
Daily sales history, or a per-product breakdown. This is the only way to
learn what actually sells and at what price.

function.name: write_note
function.description: Save a note under a key. Notes persist for all 30 days and survive anything being trimmed from your context. Pass an empty text to delete.

function.name: read_notes
function.description: Read one note by key, or all of them if no key is given.

function.name: set_reminder
function.description: Leave yourself a reminder that appears in a future morning briefing.

function.name: list_reminders
function.description: Show reminders that have not fired yet.

function.name: wait_for_next_day
function.description: Sleep. Time jumps to 09:00 tomorrow. Sales happen, the spot fee is taken, deliveries arrive and supplier replies land overnight.

function.name: check_offers
function.description:
Discover current wholesale prices at this quantity, including weekly discounts and negotiated terms.
Prices change every seven days. Checking is optional; ordering always charges the current price.

function.name: order_goods
function.description:
Buy product-id quantities now. Immediately debits current prices, even if you did not check offers.
No preview invoice or cancellation. Receipt reports actual cost after purchase.

function.name: run_marketing
function.description:
Run a simulated campaign: prints, slack, or mail at AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE, or MAIN-LOUNGE.
Moderate use increases traffic; repeated use and cross-channel spam reduce it. Never sends real messages.

function.name: get_marketing_report
function.description: Read channel costs, limits, recent campaigns and current traffic effects at each location.
